# Step-by-step assembly guide

Each algorithm family lists the assembly steps for its workspaces: which blocks are needed, how they connect, what result to expect, and which interfaces can only be called as a whole today.

- [Symmetric ciphers and modes](./symmetric.en.md)（16）
- [Hashing, XOF, and message authentication](./hash.en.md)（8）
- [Key derivation and password processing](./kdf.en.md)（5）
- [Random-bit generation](./rng.en.md)（2）
- [RSA](./rsa.en.md)（2）
- [SM2](./sm2.en.md)（4）
- [Elliptic curves and identity-based cryptography](./ecc.en.md)（5）
- [ZUC stream cipher](./zuc.en.md)（2）
- [Post-quantum cryptography (lattice-based and shared components)](./pq-lattice.en.md)（5）
- [Post-quantum cryptography (hash-based teaching components)](./pq-hash.en.md)（3）
- [Code-based, multivariate, and shared math components](./code-based.en.md)（7）

This index is built from the workspaces and registered evidence in the repository. Step-by-step block chains are authoritative here; the pages under `docs/demos/` only cover scenarios, inputs/outputs, and boundaries. Block roles are described in the block reference.
